seo.title: Affiliate Disclosure | Dollar Bets
seo.meta_description: How Dollar Bets may earn money. Affiliate links, compensation, and what it does and does not affect.

body.content: Dollar Bets may earn compensation when users click links, sign up, or take action with third-party platforms. This compensation may come from referral links, affiliate links, sponsorships, or commercial partnerships.
what compensation does and does not affect

Compensation does not determine our editorial voice, market selection, rankings, payout labels, or quips. We feature markets because they are interesting, funny, timely, absurd, high-upside, or culturally relevant — not because a partner paid us to say something is a good idea.

Dollar Bets does not operate sportsbooks, casinos, exchanges, prediction markets, or event-contract platforms. Any account opening, market participation, trading, wagering, eligibility, or payout is handled entirely by the third-party platform you visit.

Availability varies by jurisdiction. A link appearing on Dollar Bets does not mean the linked platform is available, legal, or appropriate for every visitor. Always check the platform's own terms, eligibility rules, and location restrictions before taking any action.

Nothing on Dollar Bets is betting, financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. We are an entertainment and market-discovery site. The affiliate model keeps the lights on while we do it — that's the whole arrangement, and now you know.

compliance: Dollar Bets may earn affiliate commissions from third-party platforms. This disclosure is made in accordance with FTC guidelines.
